findings.charge: recordedInputs is a byte-identical copy of v2's block. It asserts this artifact's measurement HEAD as 665415a — a commit at which none of the four artifacts v3 exists to measure had been created — while the artifact's own top-level head correctly reads 5d5d778. The block that records what was measured therefore names a repository state in which the measurement could not have been performed, and it omits all four of the new inputs.
evidence: recordedInputs in v2 and in v3 compare == equal. Every key and every value is identical; the key set is the same ten entries in both.

The two artifacts' top-level head fields differ and are each correct for their own authoring: v2 carries 665415a, v3 carries 5d5d778. So v3 updated the top-level head and left the HEAD inside recordedInputs at v2's value. The artifact contains two HEAD assertions that contradict each other and offers no reconciliation.
git dates the claimed HEAD: commit 665415a, 'D-163: record permission-leftover-join.v2', committed 2026-08-16T02:09:17-07:00.

The four artifacts v3's thesis rests on all postdate that commit by hours: harness.DR-G21.component-failure-containment.v3 at 04:56:55, its Claude review at 05:00:54, harness.DR-G12.doctor-purge.preview.v4 at 05:14:22, its Claude review at 05:51:08. The COORD digest in the block, 9d8be34b…, is confirmed by git to be COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md exactly as of commit 665415a. Live COORD is 38297e5b… and is clean in the working tree at HEAD 5d5d778. So the whole block is a D-163-era snapshot, not a v3 measurement.
findings.whyThisIsNotPedantry: The product of a leftover-join is a measurement, and v3's entire new content is one measurement: that the G12 and G21 harness specifications now exist with Claude ACCEPT 0/0, which is what moves OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC and OBL-G21-HARNESS-SPEC out of leftoverDesign. recordedInputs is the block that says at what state that measurement was taken. As written it says D-163, three commits and roughly six hours before the artifact, and hours before three of the four inputs existed. A coordinator recording this at a later D-000 and re-deriving from recordedInputs would land at 665415a and find the G12 and G21 artifacts absent, so the flip would be unreproducible from the artifact's own record. v2 was ADOPTED at D-164 partly on the accuracy of this block for v2; carrying it forward unchanged makes it false for v3.
refutationAttempted: Read the remeasurementClause as covering it. The clause is about cited FILES moving and expressly tolerates 'append-only COORD growth or COORD heading hygiene' as PASS-NO-SCOPE-EFFECT. I grant that defence for the COORD digest alone — D-164 and D-165 are appends and D-166 is literally 'remove the duplicate D-165 heading', so the COORD movement is exactly the excused kind, and I do not charge the COORD mismatch on its own. But the clause says nothing about HEAD, and no clause about files moving can license recording a measurement HEAD at which the measured artifacts did not yet exist. That is not a file that moved; it is a provenance claim that is false for this artifact.

Read recordedInputs as deliberately scoped to inputs inherited from the predecessor round, with basedOn carrying the new ones. Two things defeat this. The block is not labelled as inherited or as predecessor-scoped anywhere. And it carries a bare key 'HEAD', which on any reading is a claim about this artifact's own measurement state, not the predecessor's — v2 used it that way, correctly, for v2.

Argue the defect changes no conclusion because basedOn independently pins the four inputs and they all measure equal. I verified that and it is true, which is why this is one blocker rather than several: the substantive flip is supported by evidence that checks out. But an artifact whose declared output is a measurement cannot carry a measurement record that is false about when and against what it was taken.

verdictStatement: REJECT at 1 blocker and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The substance holds and I want that on the record: all ten basedOn digests and the file08Pin measure equal, including the four new inputs; the G12 v4 and G21 v3 reviews genuinely record ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 shouldFix with no Codex file for either; the leftoverDesign set moves from ten to eight by removing exactly OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC and OBL-G21-HARNESS-SPEC and adding nothing, so none of the eight obligations the dispatch protects is touched; DR-114 leftover-design is not claimed closed, no DR-G* row is added, required-now is 26, nothing is QUALIFIED or SATISFIED, no D-167 recording is claimed, v2 is unmoved at 874af09a and the subject did not move. It fails on provenance. recordedInputs is byte-identical to v2's block: it asserts HEAD 665415a, a commit git dates to 02:09:17, while the artifact's own top-level head correctly reads 5d5d778 — two contradictory HEAD claims in one file. Three of the four artifacts this join exists to measure were created between 04:56 and 05:51, hours after that commit, and none of the four appears in the block at all. For an artifact whose only product is a measurement, the record of what was measured names a state in which the measurement was impossible.
